title: High School Game Jam
description: This was the first game jam I ever did. Our team made the project in Unity, but we had some issues with the submission. In the end, it was fine and I learned a lot from this experience. It taught me how to be a better programmer and how to work under pressure. I knew I would be unable to make the project as well as I wanted, but it was okay. We ended up with a gameboard type game that was not too bad.

title: Ultimate Mini Golf Game Jam
description: A fun game jam using 8th Wall. I had very little experience with 8th Wall in the past, so this allowed me to truly understand how to use it and helped improve my skills a lot. We made two minigolf holes — one more professional, one all about the theming. The first 2 holes were not created by us, but the last 2 were.

title: Garfield Goobers
description: The 'Enehana Computer Science Club ran a game jam. We made a platformer where you avoid cannonballs and spikes as a beach ball to collect a key. If you survive to unlock the treasure chest, you become a rocket and must avoid octo-guards in a cave blocking the ending. Our team was the Garfield Goobers and we won first place.
